caches.name: The trapper's cache on Otter

spots.name: the cairn on the high ground

caches.found: Wrapped in a beaver pelt, {cash} and an old silver medal from the fur-trade days.
caches.note: A trapper's letter to his brother: "What I have put by is on Otter, where you and I went in '91. Under the stones or under the floor, you know which."

caches.name: The cache on Cat Island
caches.found: A tobacco tin under the stones: {cash} in banknotes, gone soft with damp.
caches.note: A fish buyer's tally with a line under it: "Cat Isl. — under the stones — till spring."

caches.name: The cache on Gull Island
caches.found: Wedged under the cairn among the gull droppings, a canvas bag: {cash}.
caches.note: A smuggler's receipt with "Gull rock — the cairn" pencilled on the back.

caches.name: The cache on Oak Island
caches.found: An oilcloth packet: {cash}, and a note in a hand you don't know: "For whoever finds it. I won't be back."
caches.note: A letter from a lumber camp foreman: "The money's on Oak, high up. If I'm taken, get it before the company does."

caches.name: The cache on Manitou
caches.found: A crock with a wooden lid: {cash}, a fisherman's savings.
caches.note: A pawn ticket, and on the back: "Manitou. The cabin. Floor or behind it."

caches.name: The cache on Michigan Island
caches.found: Under the cairn's top stones, a powder flask stuffed with {cash} in banknotes.
caches.note: A sailor's letter, never posted: "Left it on Michigan Island, at the lookout, under the stones."

caches.name: The cache on Basswood
caches.found: In a jar sealed with wax: {cash}, a quarryman's last wages kept from the company.
caches.note: A quarryman's letter home: "I kept back what I could. It's on Basswood, high up or in the barn."

caches.name: The cache on Madeline's north end
caches.where: on the north end of Madeline Island
caches.found: Under the stones, an old cartridge box: {cash} and a pair of gold cufflinks, sold later for their weight.
caches.note: A La Pointe trader's ledger with a corner turned down: "North end. Lookout or Joe's cabin."
